title: Why with replacement?

choices: The medians vary more than they should
All 10,000 medians are identical: each resample is the same 500 rows in a new order
It works the same as with replacement
explanations: Drawing 500 of 500 rows without replacement is allowed; it just reshuffles.
Without replacement, drawing all 500 rows returns the original sample.

hints: How many rows are drawn, and how many exist?
Drawing every row once, in some order …
… gives the same median every time.
solution: Without replacement, 500 draws from 500 rows is just a reshuffle, so every resample has the same median.
